headline: China keeps benchmark loan rates unchanged for an 18th consecutive month
summary: China left its benchmark lending rates unchanged in November, the 18th consecutive month without a change, in line with market expectations.
why: China's loan prime rates are the benchmark lending rates set by the central bank's monthly fixing, shaping borrowing costs across the economy.
original_headline: China mantiene sin cambios sus tasas de referencia para préstamos por 18º mes consecutivo
